text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, a machine learning and AI developer with 6 years of experience building practical Python-based systems.

I’d be excited to help build your healthcare management system with AI incorporated and prepare a solid beta within your 3-month timeline. My background includes Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning, so I can contribute both to the AI layer and the broader application flow.

Recently, I built a Delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics using Python, OpenAI API, LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Twilio. It handled parcel tracking and delivery rescheduling, with 43% of conversations resolved without an agent and a CSAT score of 4.4 out of 5.

I’d love to discuss how to structure the medical records workflow, AI features, and API integration for your beta.
